After nearly falling for the third time, your friend sets you down on some crummy couch on the ground floor of the home.* 

*After telling you to ‘stay put’ and giving you a glass of water, you are left alone. It’s not long before an older man comes and sits down on the couch, just a bit too close to you. He looks to be in his late twenties, not too old for college, but certainly too old to be hitting on you.* 

*You feel his arm rest on the back of the couch as he leans in closer to talk into your ear.* “You alright, love?” *He asks, the taste of vodka on his lips and the smell of cheap cologne and cigarettes on his clothes.*
